description.text: Babolat Air Crest 2026: light, forgiving and easy to handle

Babolat built the Air Crest 2026 for beginner and intermediate players who are starting to improve and still want a comfortable racket. The head is an oversized teardrop , the balance is medium and it weighs 345 g . It's a light racket, and you notice it most at the net and in quick exchanges.

Its fibreglass faces and soft EVA core give a soft touch and easy ball output from the first match. The Oversize Sweetspot makes the racket more tolerant of off-centre hits, so shots stay precise even when your timing isn't perfect. It comes in black and grey with a matt finish.
What does the oversized teardrop shape bring to your game?

Power and control in similar amounts , for both defence and attack. The medium balance spreads the weight evenly along the racket, so it feels stable in your hand. Because the head is oversized, the sweet spot is bigger too, and balls you don't hit cleanly still go over with some precision.
How hard is the Air Crest 2026?

It's a soft racket . The fibreglass faces give a more flexible touch, and the soft EVA core cushions each hit and reduces vibration. The hybrid carbon and fibreglass frame adds the rigidity and durability that a soft racket needs, making it a good fit for players who value comfort over a stiff, demanding feel.
Key features and technology in the Babolat Air Crest 2026

items: Oversize Sweetspot — a larger sweet spot for more tolerance and more precise shots
Hybrid Frame — carbon and fibreglass for rigidity, flexibility and durability
Improver Heart — better weight distribution and a correct racket position
Fibreglass faces — comfortable ball output and a more flexible touch
Soft EVA core — soft cushioning that reduces vibration
Flat surface with a matt finish
Teardrop shape with a medium balance
345 g weight for quick, precise movements

description.text: Will the Air Crest 2026 help me improve my technique?

Yes — the Improver Heart helps keep the racket in the correct position, and the Oversize Sweetspot forgives mistakes while you work on your strokes. Combined with its low weight, that makes it easier to focus on technique rather than fighting the racket.
Is it light enough for fast play at the net?
Yes — at 345 g it's noticeably light, so you can react quickly on volleys and in fast exchanges. That lightness also means less fatigue over a long session.
Is the Babolat Air Crest 2026 worth it?
Yes — if you're a beginner or intermediate player looking for a light, comfortable racket that forgives mistakes while you work on your game.

This padel racket is presented as an innovative and exciting option for padel players looking for exceptional performance on the court.
Design and format:

The padel racket comes in a diamond format, a design choice that combines power with manageability in an exceptional way. Innovative technologies:

This padel racket incorporates two advanced technologies: Texture 3D , which allows players to print impressive effects on the ball, and Pulse System , which reduces vibrations and joint fatigue, providing exceptional comfort during long and intense matches.
Nox AT10 Genius 18K Agustín Tapia 2024: power and precision for advanced players

The Nox AT10 Genius 18K Agustín Tapia 2024 sits among the standout rackets in Nox's current padel racket range. This teardrop-shaped, medium-balance racket is built to give advanced players a genuine blend of power and control, rather than forcing a trade-off between the two.

Solid, comfortable contact is the priority here. New materials and construction techniques give the racket a more consistent feel off the face, along with the stability players need when the pace of the rally picks up.
Technologies behind the AT10 Genius 18K 2024

A 100% carbon frame forms the base of the racket, giving it the rigidity and durability to hold up over full seasons of competitive play. DCS (Dynamic Composite Structure) reinforces the join between frame and hitting surface, adding extra resistance against off-centre hits.

The EOS Flap system — lateral perforations along the frame — redistributes weight to make the racket faster through the air and easier to manoeuvre at the net. On the faces, Aluminised Carbon 18K stays light without losing consistency, producing clean, powerful ball output on both flat drives and smashes.

Inside, a Multilayer MLD Black EVA core rounds out the package with an exceptional feel at contact. Together, this combination gives the racket its medium hardness — precise enough for controlled placement, forgiving enough not to punish a slightly off-centre shot.
Grip and comfort through long matches

Pulse System inserts absorb vibration on impact, while Nox Custom Grip keeps the handle secure without extra effort from your hand. The SmartStrap safety cord swaps out in seconds too, with no need to remove the bottom cap — a small but welcome upgrade in everyday use.
Built for the advanced game

This racket suits players who already compete at a good level and want to sharpen their control without giving up power. Its rough, sandy surface adds spin on demand, and the generous sweet spot keeps returns precise even under pressure from the fastest rallies.
Am I good enough for this racket?

If you're still building consistent contact or developing your smash, this racket's medium hardness won't do the work for you — a softer all-round racket will get you better results while you build technique. If you already play at an advanced level, the AT10 Genius 18K rewards clean hitting with real precision.
Will this racket feel too stiff on my arm during a long match?

No — the MLD Black EVA core and Pulse System inserts are there specifically to absorb vibration on impact, so it stays comfortable even in three-set matches. You'll feel firmness on powerful shots, not harshness.
Will I notice more power or more control when I play with it?

Control comes first. The medium hardness and generous sweet spot are built to reward precise placement over raw pace — you'll still get plenty of power on your smash, but this isn't a racket that hits hard by accident.

An important aspect to highlight is the Vibradrive system incorporated in this padel racket, which absorbs vibrations to provide a feeling of comfort in the game and reduce the risk of repetitive strain injuries.

Its diamond mold and high balance make it an ideal model if you are looking for maximum power in your attacking plays. Your shots will be lethal. Its weight is between 365 and 375 grams, so it offers good maneuverability.
CarboTube frame for more power and control
Thanks to its Vertex core , power and weight are evenly distributed for solid volleys and power-packed shots, while reducing twisting and vibration.

The core is made of a dual density Multiveva rubber , which allows the player to adapt to the type of stroke, responding effectively to slower balls with great control and with excellent power on fast strokes.

The composition of the planes is based on Xtend Carbon 12K , a few intertwined carbon fibers that provides rigidity and strength, while reducing weight as it is a material up to 30% lighter than ordinary carbon.
Combines the AIR POWER and the CURVAKTIV

The grip incorporates the Hesacore, a very innovative grip that generates a larger contact surface, which reduces effort, injuries and the transmission of vibrations. In the grip it incorporates the Grip Custom Weight system, which allows the modification of the balance and weight of the padel racket.
On the faces we find the TOPSPIN technology, a rough finish that facilitates the grip of the ball to the surface to hit the ball with much more effect.

It also includes Vibradrive technology, a mounting system that inserts a piece of very elastic rubber that is responsible for absorbing vibrations and improve the overall feel of the game, especially in off-center hits.
Bullpadel Vertex 04 Comfort: controlled power for advanced play

The Bullpadel Vertex 04 Comfort is the padel racket Martin Di Nenno chose to compete with in the 2024 season, and it's built around one idea: give advanced and professional players maximum power without losing control over the shot. Its diamond shape and high balance load every stroke with extra power, while the frame keeps that power manageable rather than erratic.

Weight sits between 360 and 370 grams with a 38mm profile — on the heavier, more powerful end of the Bullpadel Vertex 04 range, built for players who already generate their own pace and want the racket to add to it, not create it for them.
Materials that shape how it hits

The CarbonTube frame uses 100% bi-directional interlocking carbon fibre, combining the CURVAKTIV system with AIR POWER to resist twisting and spread stress evenly through the racket on off-centre contact. The hitting surface adds Fibrix HybridFiber, a bi-directional blend of X-Glass and carbon that gives the core some elasticity and flex rather than pure stiffness.

Inside, a dual-density Multieva core pairs a softer inner layer with a firmer, compact outer layer. That combination is what lets the racket handle both a slow, controlled volley and a fast-paced smash without feeling like two different rackets.
Where the comfort comes from

The Vertex core distributes weight to cut down on torsion, reducing vibration and adding rigidity where it matters for solid, powerful volleys. On the faces, TOPSPIN texture adds extra grip on the ball, so effect shots bite rather than skid. The Custom Weight Grip on the handle lets you fine-tune weight and balance to your own game, rather than accepting the racket exactly as it ships.
Will this racket suit my level?
If you're not yet generating consistent power on your own shots, the high balance here will work against you — a medium-balance racket will be more forgiving while you build technique.
Will I feel a lot of vibration on mishits?

Less than you'd expect from a power racket. The Vertex core and Multieva's softer inner layer are there specifically to cut vibration, so off-centre hits sting less than on a stiffer, single-density racket.
Can I adjust it if the balance feels too head-heavy?
Yes — the Custom Weight Grip on the handle lets you shift weight and balance to suit your swing, so you're not stuck with the factory setup if the power feels harder to control at first.
Pegasus Revolution 3K, for a winning spirit
The new Siux Pegasus Revolution 3K is a racket that has been designed for advanced or professional level padel players who want maximum power in each shot. It is perfect for a versatile game.

This Siux 2023 racket has a hybrid shape with medium balance , that is, it combines round and teardrop shapes to offer the player the advantages of both formats, achieving a perfect balance between power and control. It also has a medium touch.
Part of the Pro Line Series range

With a weight between 355 and 375 grams , the Pegasus Revolution 3K features faces made with narrower 3K carbon that increases the hardness and smoothness of the surface to achieve more power. The finish of the faces is matte, which gives the racket more elegance and subtlety.
The twin-tube carbon frame is joined with the four-armed heart, absorbing vibrations after impacts and reducing the possibility of injury.

If we focus on its inner core, we find EVA rubber , a light rubber that stands out for offering control in slow and soft shots, power in the most intense and aggressive shots, as well as greater durability.
Vibration reduction

It incorporates a ShockOut system in the lower holes in order to reduce vibrations after the impact of the ball. In addition, it integrates the Dual Pro Grip in the handle, made with foam , which guarantees a more natural grip.
As for its design, it features a total black aesthetic with some small details in orange. This colour combination achieves an elegant, understated and powerful appearance that will turn heads.

description.text: Siux Diablo Go 3, good control in the stroke
Fresh from the Siux Go Series , comes the new Diablo Go 3 , a hybrid padel racket for advanced padel players looking for versatility and adaptability in each stroke.

In terms of its format, it has a hybrid mold and a medium balance , so the player can enjoy superior power, precision and control at all times. This will allow you to adapt to any playing style and situation.
Its light weight, between 355 and 375 grams , guarantees excellent freedom of movement, agility and unprecedented speed. You will return every drop shot, even at the baseline.
Faster and more precise movements

The planes of this Siux 2024 padel racket have a matte finish and are made of 3K Carbon , a material known for its great durability and resistance, which guarantees the integrity of the racket, even with intense use.

On the other hand, in the core we find EVA rubber , a foam that provides a comfortable, soft touch and a great ball output in any style of play. It provides versatility and adaptability, as it adjusts to the needs of both aggressive players looking for power and defensive players looking for control.

The tubular frame is made with a combination of 50% 3K Carbon and 50% fiberglass . This provides exceptional stiffness and durability that increases the life of the padel racket by resisting the most intense impacts and wear. It also provides good control and minimizes vibrations .
Superb comfort
It also incorporates Dampeners Shockout technology, anti-vibration shock absorbers that reduce vibrations by up to 60%, protecting your joints from unwanted injuries.
Its design exudes power, energy and elegance , as it combines black and red colors, with some white details. The result is an attractive, modern aesthetic that will turn heads.
Siux Diablo Revolution JR 3, designed for promising young padel players.

Designed to provide excellent performance to those beginner level padel players looking to learn a good technique from the start, the Siux Diablo Revolution JR 3 is the ideal choice if you want to get a good base.
This Siux 2024 padel racket is perfectly suited to the needs of junior players, giving them the confidence and tools they need to enjoy a versatile game .
Control and power for versatile games

The hybrid mold and low balance ensures an optimal balance between power and control. This allows players to feel comfortable in both offense and defense, and to adapt to different situations on the court.

The padel racket has a light weight of between 310 and 340 grams , which provides the agility and maneuverability needed to move quickly on the court and perfect their technique. It also allows them to play longer without experiencing fatigue.
Great adaptability
The EVA Soft rubber core offers controlled ball exit. This medium density foam not only provides comfort when hitting, but also allows optimal adaptability to various playing styles and needs.

The use of fiberglass in the frame and faces of the padel racket provides high strength and durability, which translates into a longer lifespan. In addition, fiberglass reduces vibrations and the discomfort produced by these in the joints, which guarantees the player's well-being by minimizing the possibility of injury.

In terms of design, the combination of the black and red of the planes, with a glossy finish , with the white of the frame and the linear details on the sides, stands out. It adds a touch of style and visual appeal.
Siux Electra ST3 Go, hybrid padel racket for intermediate level players.

The Siux Electra ST3 Go padel racket is from the Siux Go Series range, designed specifically for intermediate players who want to improve their game and take it to the next level. With a sleek black and gold design, this padel racket not only stands out on the court for its performance, but also for its impeccable aesthetics.

The racket features a hybrid-shaped body that combines the best of the round and teardrop padel racquets, making it a versatile ally on the court. Its medium balance provides exceptional control without sacrificing power in your shots. The weight range of this padel racket is between 355 and 375 grams.
Medium-hard feel hybrid padel racket.

The tubular structure of the padel racket is composed of 50% 3K carbon and 50% Fiber Glass , which guarantees exceptional strength and long-lasting durability. The faces are made of 3K carbon , which provides greater flexibility to the planes. The EVA Hard rubber core offers a medium-hard feel, providing a solid and controlled feel at every impact.

It is equipped with an anti-vibration Dampeners Shockout system , which reduces vibrations on impact, providing a more comfortable playing experience and minimizing the risk of repetitive strain injuries. The gloss finish faces give it a sleek and polished look on the court.

In short, the Siux Electra ST3 Go is the perfect choice for mid-performance padel players looking for a racket with an ideal balance between control and power , exceptional durability, and stunning aesthetics. With its advanced technology and attractive design, this padel racket will take you one step closer to victory in every match.
Siux Electra ST3 Stupa Pro, good manageability

The Siux Electra ST3 Stupa Pro is a medium touch hybrid padel racket that is part of the Siux Pro Series . It is designed for advanced or professional padel players and is the official racket of the player Franco Stupaczuk .

It has a hybrid shape with a medium balance, making it a very balanced padel racket that gives power in attacking shots and control in defensive plays. It provides a perfect combination of power and control.
On the other hand, it has a weight between 355 and 375 grams , which means that you can handle it very easily due to its lightness and you can move around the court without any limitation.
Versatility and good adaptability

The faces of this Siux men's padel racket are composed of Carbon 15K 20*40 Textreme , a high quality carbon fabric with a pattern of 20 threads by 40 threads, which provides stiffness, strength and an excellent balance between control and power. In addition, the flats have a shiny and sandy finish , which makes the ball spin with more speed and spin.

The tubular frame is made of 3K Carbon and Aramid , which provide the padel racket with superior wear resistance, control and durability. Also, vibrations are reduced while increasing comfort. The inner core incorporates EVA Hard rubber , which offers good ball exit and rebound.
Unique style

If we focus on its design, we can highlight the combination of the simplicity of the body of the padel racket with the metallic details and the metallic yellow of the bridge, which achieves a harmonious and unique contrast.

description.text: Siux Fenix IV Go, strokes full of power
Focused for intermediate padel players, the Siux Fenix IV Go is a hybrid racket with high balance and hard touch that provides supreme power in aggressive plays at the red.

As for its shape, its hybrid mold and high balance make it an ideal padel racket for those more aggressive players who enjoy making powerful and fast volleys. In addition, thanks to its weight, which ranges between 355 and 375 grams , it is easy to handle due to its lightness and good maneuverability.
Ideal for aggressive players

If we focus on its composition, we can highlight the 3K carbon of its planes, as it is a narrower, stronger and smoother fiber, which achieves shots full of power, ideal for hits at the red. The faces have a smooth glossy finish .

On the other hand, the tubular frame has been manufactured by combining 50% 3K carbon and 50% fiberglass , making it a strong, durable padel racket, which ensures incredible sensations when hitting for its lightness, quality and high performance.

The core, on the other hand, is made of EVA Hard rubber , a high hardness foam that generates greater power when hitting, as well as good control. It also provides greater stability and firmness when hitting the ball and has a great capacity to absorb vibrations.
Firmness and stability

Likewise, with the aim of improving the performance of the Siux Fenix IV Go, the Dampeners Shockout anti-vibration pads have been incorporated, a technology that improves the general sensations and provides extra comfort by optimally absorbing the vibrations produced after the impact of the ball.

Aesthetically, it is worth highlighting its design with copper details, which perfectly combines the black of the carbon in the planes with a graphic texture on the other half of the padel racket's face.
Siux Fenix 4 Pro, ideal for aggressive players.
Designed for professional level padel players who enjoy printing power at the red, the Siux Fenix 4 Pro is a diamond padel racket that allows you to be aggressive in attacking plays.

Its diamond mold and high balance make it the perfect ally if you are looking for unstoppable and powerful shots, as well as high performance on the court. It weighs between 355 and 375 grams , which allows for comfortable handling and optimal freedom of movement due to its light weight.
Vibration reduction

On the other hand, it has been made with premium quality materials such as 18K Textreme 45º Carbon that make up the faces of this Siux padel racket . This material is highly resistant and durable. The planes have a glossy finish with 3D relief , which adds effect to the shots, as the ball grips more and spins with more speed.
At the core we find EVA Hard rubber , a high density foam that provides superior control in the direction and placement of the ball. It also reduces vibration at impact.

The tubular frame is made of 13K carbon + Aramid , which offers greater rigidity and resistance thanks to the strength and durability of the frame. It is a lightweight material, so it has a controlled weight.
Siux Fenix IV Lite, lethal attacks
Designed for advanced or professional padel players, the Siux Fenix IV Lite is the ideal hard touch padel racket if you are looking for power-packed strokes and aggressive attacking plays.

It has a diamond shape with a high balance , so you can enjoy a huge power to have a higher point of impact that allows better control in shots such as smashes or auctions. You will hit with a high effectiveness at the red.
In addition, thanks to its weight, which ranges between 355 and 375 grams, you will enjoy great freedom of movement, lightness and agility when moving around the court.
Elasticity and versatility

If we focus on its composition, it is worth mentioning the 3K Twill carbon in the planes, as it is a hard and resistant fiber that does not flex excessively and requires less effort to recover its original shape after impact, which extends the life of the padel racket. The Twill weave is composed of diagonally interwoven yarns, which allows for a more open position and greater elasticity.
The surface also has a matte finish and 3D relief , which means the ball can grip better and spin faster for more spin.

The frame, on the other hand, is made of 3K Carbon , which provides great control and precision when hitting. Meanwhile, the core incorporates EVA Hard rubber , a dense and hard foam that generates power and absorbs the vibration of the impacts in an optimal way. It also provides versatility and extra stability.
Optimal joint protection

As additional details, we can mention the Dual Pro Grip and Dampeners Shockout technologies. The first consists of a grip made of FOAM rubber, which favors a more comfortable, firm and natural grip, and the second is an anti-vibration system that improves overall sensations and provides comfort and protection to the player.

description.text: Adidas Drive 3.3 Vintage, ideal if you're looking for control
The Adidas Drive 3.3 Vintage is a model designed to offer a controlled stroke and good performance to those padel players who are in the initiation phase and are learning the basics of the sport.

It has a rounded shape with a low balance , that is, the weight is distributed towards the wrist area, so that excellent control is achieved in each stroke. In addition, its wide sweet spot and centering makes it easy to hit. It weighs between 360 and 375 grams and has a surface area of 519 cm2.
As for its design, a color scheme in nude tones has been used, combining brown details with the off-white of the padel racket's body. It is a simple and vintage aesthetic , as its name indicates.
Greater resistance to shocks

The frame is made of fiberglass , a very flexible and durable material with great responsiveness and vibration absorption, which provides unbeatable comfort. It guarantees easy and controlled handling .

The flats, on the other hand, are also made of fiberglass, so when the padel racket is in a static position or in those low-speed shots, the rubber will work harder and a greater rebound will be achieved with minimum effort .
Reinforced areas of increased torsion
Also, this Adidas 2024 padel racket incorporates durability technologies, which are responsible for increasing the resistance of the padel racket against high torsion to extend its life.
We note the Smart Holes Linear , which consists of an arrangement of the holes of the planes in groups of 3. That gets the surface is reinforced and durability increases.

On the other hand, we find the Structural Reinforcement , a system that generates more resistance to the torsions suffered by the padel racket during the match through the use of perimeter reinforcements throughout the padel racket.

description.text: Adidas Adipower Multiweight 3.3, more speed and control.
Designed for high-level padel players who practice the sport frequently and intensely, the Adidas Adipower Multiweight 3.3 provides superb control on fast movements.
It has a rounded shape, low balance and a centered sweet spot, making it ideal if you are looking for improved control and easy maneuverability.

Due to the weight system located on the rail of the edge Weight & Balance System Multiweight , this padel racket has the particularity of being able to modify its weight, adding up to 9 grams distributed in 7 screws, to adapt the balance to the needs of the moment.
Optimized resistance
In terms of materials, the frame is made of carbon fiber , while the faces are made of 18K carbon fiber interwoven filaments. This material guarantees great durability, rigidity and resistance.
On the other hand, in the core we find the high density EVA High Memory rubber , a foam that stands out for providing supreme power in the fastest strokes.
Full of effect hits

It also has an inner carbon rib in the frame called Power Embossed Ridge , which is responsible for increasing the rigidity of the structure. Thanks to the Dual Exoskeleton , the frame and the heart of the padel racket are reinforced so that the player can exert more force on each stroke.
In the same way, to improve durability it includes the Structural Reinforcement , which consists of perimeter reinforcements that resist high torsion.

And with the intention that the player can hit the ball with much more effect and be able to surprise their opponents more easily, it incorporates the Spin Blade Decal relief and the Smart Holes Curve , an arrangement of the holes designed to facilitate the use of effects.
Adidas Cross It Light 2024, firm, comfortable and controlled stroke.

Designed to offer excellent performance on court to those padel players of advanced or professional level , the Adidas Cross It Light provides exceptional control in each stroke. It is the official padel racket of Martita Ortega for the 2024 season.

If we focus on its shape, it is worth noting its round shape with low balance because, by distributing the weight towards the foot, it gives the player a lot of control and extra protection against arm injuries. Its sweet spot is wide and located in the center.
Strength and durability
This Adidas 2024 padel racket has a core composed of EVA Soft Energy rubber , a medium density foam that provides a fast ball exit and exceptional power.

In addition, the planes have been manufactured with Carbon Aluminized 24K , a material that, thanks to its low flexibility, guarantees greater power and speed in the most aggressive shots. The frame is made of 50% carbon fiber , which increases strength, lightness and durability .
More spin on your shots
The Adidas Cross IT Light also integrates high-performance technologies to increase the power, spin and durability of the padel racket.

The Dynamic Air Flow technology promotes air flow through the core, which makes the padel racket easier to handle, while the Power Extra Grip generates greater inertia and slightly shifts the sweet spot upwards for more power.
On the other hand, we find the Spin Blade Mold system, which consists of a 3D embossed roughness located in the mold to increase power and grip while hitting the ball with more spin.

In order to increase the durability of the padel racket and extend its useful life, it incorporates the Structural Reinforcement technology, which consists of perimeter reinforcements that generate greater resistance to high torsion.

Adidas presents the new Drive 3.3 Blue padel racket , a model aimed at beginner padel players looking to learn a good technique from the beginning based on excellent control in the stroke.

If we focus on its shape, it is worth noting its round shape, with low balance and large sweet spot in the center . This ensures that the athlete can hit the ball with great precision, control and certainty. It is a very manageable padel racket, which allows for quick movements.

In order to facilitate a comfortable and firm hit, the Adidas Drive 3.3 Blue includes a surface of 519 cm2, something typical of padel racquets for beginners. In addition, it weighs between 360 and 375 grams .
High quality and performance

The core of this Adidas 2024 padel racket is made of a low-density EVA rubber called Soft Performance . Its low density allows the ball to bounce more and come out with power while providing comfort in low-speed shots or with a static padel racket.

Also, the planes have been manufactured with fiberglass, a highly flexible material that provides a greater spring effect and more output of the ball in slow shots from the bottom of the court. Its soft feel ensures optimal prevention of arm injuries.

Likewise, fiberglass has been used to manufacture the frame, making the Drive 3.3 Blue a durable, lightweight, strong and responsive padel racket. Reduces vibrations at the elbow and wrist, minimizing fatigue and injury.
High resistance to high torsion
In terms of technologies, this model incorporates two technologies focused on reinforcing those areas of the padel racket that are most vulnerable to high torsion, thus improving its durability .
It has Structural Reinforcement and Smart Holes Linear . The former is responsible for increasing resistance and the latter reinforces the surface by means of an arrangement of holes in groups of 3.

The Adidas Metalbone Carbon 3.3 2024 is Pablo Cardona's official racket, an oversize diamond-shaped padel racket built for high-performance, advanced-level players. It's designed with frequent, intense matches in mind rather than the occasional weekend game — the kind of racket that's meant to take a beating and keep performing.
Its high balance loads finishing shots with real power, and a Metalbone Protector Tape guards the frame against the friction and wear that build up over heavy use.
Materials built for durability and spin

The frame is carbon fibre — light but genuinely strong — and the faces use flexible 6K carbon fibre for durability that holds up over full seasons. Inside, an EVA Soft Performance core keeps things low-density and soft underfoot, giving you comfort and a touch more control on the ball without losing bounce on contact.

Spin is a real focus here. Spin Blade Decal roughens the face finish to grip the ball better, while Smart Holes Curves — curved drilling through the frame — opens up more access to add effect on your shots.
Rigidity where the frame needs it most

An octagonal tubular design, built with Octagonal Structure technology, keeps the body rigid under pressure. Structural Reinforcement technology then reinforces the perimeter of the frame specifically to resist twisting on off-centre hits — a common failure point on lighter diamond rackets.
Visually, it carries an elegant, striking finish: black body and handle, with the bridge and the Adidas logo picked out in copper.
Will this racket suit my level?

This is built for advanced, high-performance players who already play often — if your matches are occasional and casual, the high balance and stiffness here will feel like overkill. Frequent, competitive players get the payoff: a racket that holds its performance through heavy, repeated use.
Will I feel more spin or more raw power on my shots?

Both are covered, but spin is where this racket stands out. Spin Blade Decal and Smart Holes Curves are built specifically to help you add effect, while the high balance still gives you plenty of power on finishing smashes.
Will the frame hold up if I catch the ball off-centre?

Yes — that's exactly what Structural Reinforcement technology is for. It's built into the perimeter of the frame to resist twisting on off-centre contact, so mishits are less likely to affect your next shot.

name: Nox At10 Genius 12K By Agustín Tapia 2025

description.text: Nox AT10 Genius 12K by Agustín Tapia 2025: solid power, precise control

Built directly with Agustín Tapia for the 2025 season, the Nox AT10 Genius 12K is a teardrop-shaped padel racket with a medium balance — made for advanced and competition-level players after something solid and dependable.

The face is 12K carbon , paired with a multi-layer Black EVA core of medium-high hardness, and weight sits between 360-375g . Its EOS Flap redistributes that weight for easier handling, so the racket holds up whether you're attacking or defending.
What does the teardrop shape bring to your game?

The teardrop shape sits between the round and diamond formats, giving the AT10 Genius 12K a balance of power, control and manoeuvrability for an all-court game. Its sweet spot sits slightly higher on the face, helping generate pace on attacking shots while still forgiving off-centre hits — useful when rallies move fast.
Is the AT10 Genius 12K a power, control or all-round racket?

Rather than specialise in one style, the AT10 Genius 12K plays as an all-rounder — equally at home in attack and defence. It sits in Nox's men's range, aimed at players who don't want to trade control for power, or power for control.
Key features and technology in the Nox AT10 Genius 12K 2025

items: 12K Carbon face — cuts weight and adds rigidity to the frame
Exclusive Spin — a rough double-texture finish for extra grip and spin on the ball
Durable tubular carbon frame
Multi-layer Black EVA core (medium-high hardness) for a solid, consistent response
EOS Flap — redistributes weight for easier handling
Custom Grip — improves hold and reduces slipping
Pulse System — cuts vibration for a more comfortable hit
Dynamic Composite Structure — evens out the stiffness gap between frame and face
Smartstrap — a replaceable, more hygienic safety strap
Part of the Luxury Series range
Teardrop shape, 360-375g

description.text: Is the Nox AT10 Genius 12K by Agustín Tapia 2025 worth it?
Yes — it's a strong pick if you play at an advanced or competition level and want a racket that stays solid when points get long, giving you power and control from the same swing.

name: Nox At10 Genius 18K Alum By Agustín Tapia 2025

description.text: Nox AT10 Genius 18K Alum by Agustín Tapia 2025: firm feel, extra spin

Nox designed the AT10 Genius 18K Alum 2025 together with Agustín Tapia . It's a teardrop-shaped padel racket with a medium balance , made for advanced and competition-level players , and its two main traits are firmness and durability. It weighs between 360 and 375 g , and the EOS Flap redistributes that weight so it stays agile and easy to handle in fast, precise play.

The faces are Alum 18K carbon and the core is a multi-layer MLD Black EVA . On the surface, an Exclusive Spin 3D pattern with a rough sand finish adds spin and control. It comes in black and belongs to Nox's Luxury Series range.
How hard is the AT10 Genius 18K Alum?

It has a medium hardness . The hit feels firm and solid , but the Alum 18K faces keep the touch comfortable and the response uniform. The Pulse System and Custom Grip also cut down the vibration that reaches your arm.
Does it suit a defensive or an attacking player?

Both. The teardrop shape and medium balance add speed to defensive shots and power to attacks , and the MLD Black EVA core does the same: better ball output when you defend, extra power when you go on the offensive. It's a men's racket for players who enjoy both sides of the game.

A fast, precise game . The Head Coello Motion 2025 is part of Arturo Coello's exclusive collection, built for advanced players chasing the combination of power and manoeuvrability his own game is known for. Its diamond shape and medium-high balance carry his signature and crown logo, but the design is built to perform, not just to look the part — every detail is aimed at offensive shots like the smash, víbora and aggressive volley.

At 360g with a hybrid carbon surface, it's built to hit hard while staying stable through fast exchanges, giving you the kind of impact feel that rewards players who want to dominate the point rather than just survive it.
Technology behind the power

Auxetic 2.0 technology delivers an immediate response on contact, so there's minimal lag between the hit and the power you feel behind it. Power Foam adds explosive energy to every shot, while an optimised sweet spot keeps that power consistent even when contact isn't perfectly centred.

The 3D rough finish, built through Extreme Spin technology, adds real grip on the ball for players who want to load their shots with effect. Underneath, a Carbon Frame provides the durability and stiffness to hold up over a full season of aggressive play, reinforced further by Graphene Inside for extra stability and an Anti Shock Skin film that protects the frame from everyday wear.
Power Stabilizer technology rounds it out with a faster swing and better stability through the shot, so the racket keeps up when you're moving quickly between offence and defence.
Will this racket suit my level?

This is built for advanced, competitive players already comfortable generating their own power — if you're still developing consistent contact, the medium-high balance will feel demanding rather than forgiving. Players who already attack aggressively get the full benefit of what Auxetic 2.
Will I feel the impact through my arm on hard shots?

Less than you'd expect from this much power — Graphene Inside and the Anti Shock Skin work together to stabilise the frame and absorb shock, so hard hitting doesn't translate directly into arm fatigue.
Is this racket built more for smashing or for all-round play?

Smashing and aggressive net play are where it's strongest, thanks to the medium-high balance and diamond shape. If your game leans more towards patient, all-round rallying, a lower-balance racket will feel more natural through a full match.

Babolat Technical Viper 2025: maximum power for the technical attacker

The Babolat Technical Viper is built to dominate the game through explosive, precise attack. Its diamond shape, head-heavy balance and 365-gram weight put maximum power behind every smash, giving you the kind of finishing shot that decides points rather than just extends them.
Built for the technical striker

This racket suits players who combine strength with precision to be decisive in every point — the profile Babolat calls the "technical striker." If your game already leans on smashing hard and often, this diamond racket is built to reward that rather than hold you back.
Technology behind the attack

A carbon frame adds durability without sacrificing the stiffness that power shots demand. The rough 12K carbon faces increase both power and resistance to wear, and a Holes Pattern System optimises hole distribution across the face for more precision on your hardest hits.
Vibration absorption keeps the racket comfortable and safer to play with over a full match, and the Smart Buttcap makes the safety cord easy to remove and replace as needed.
Is this racket too demanding for my level?

This is built for advanced-level players who already smash with confidence — if you're still developing that shot, the head-heavy balance will feel harder to control than a more even-balanced racket. Advanced players looking to be lethal at the net get the full benefit of the extra power built into the head.
Will it take time to adapt if I'm used to a lighter, more balanced racket?

Yes, expect a short adjustment period — the head-heavy balance shifts more weight towards the top of the frame than an even-balance racket, so your swing timing on volleys may need a few sessions to recalibrate before the extra smash power starts paying off.
Will the carbon faces hold up if I play often?

Yes — the carbon frame and rough 12K carbon faces are built specifically for durability under frequent, high-intensity use, so regular smashing shouldn't wear the racket down faster than normal play would.
